content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-297. - Joint project participation.

faqs.a:
Funds for projects, the costs of which are to be funded partially by appropriations
               from the capital improvements fund and the balance by appropriations from other funds
               or assessments against real property, may be expended from the capital improvements
               fund to the extent of the appropriation therein, or transfers may be made to other
               appropriate fund for purposes of pooling, except in either instance the expenditure
               shall be deemed to be only that prorated portion of the actual project cost or appropriation,
               whichever is the smaller.
(Code 1981, § 2-72; Ord. No. 2547, § 1, 8-15-1988)
